checks: Answers survive task navigation and browser reload.
Visible-piece pointing returns an anonymous handle and neutral complete position cards; clicking a card selects without installing.
One finished question submits independently; no all-questions gate.
Reviewer B has independent empty answers, not copied from A.
Duplicate and stale action requests do not execute twice.
After the blind gate, independent reviewers can download exact before/proposed LDraw scenes without a target or engine verdict.
Mechanical checks are blinded to engine/backend verdicts and keep uncertainty rather than forcing a guess.
Evicted sessions reconstruct from the saved action log without losing answers or operations.
The 400px page fits without horizontal overflow.
Helped/non-independent feedback can be submitted and retained without earning independent qualification.
Manager summary counts actual distinct submissions; disagreement pauses admission and private records are not served.
scope: Coding/UI regression fixtures only. All simulated choices are in /tmp, isolated from participant storage.
